text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — planning a staggered rollout for feature flag `ff_slew_cohort` alongside the model-routing v2 deploy tonight. Target window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Plan: 1% -> 10% (10m) -> 50% (20m). @Deploy Bot will drive the shifts. Any blockers? :eyes:
Chris: Can we start at 22:05? There's a long-running batching job that should finish by then. Also request: pin routing to model v2.1 for the canary cohort while ramping.
Maya: 22:05 works. Pin confirmed for canary: model=v2.1. We'll unpin global after 60m if metrics look good.
Sam: Add safety thresholds: p95 latency +20% OR error rate >0.4% => immediate stop + rollback to previous ff state. Also if GPU util >75% for >3min.
Olga: +1 on thresholds. Add a short circuit: if we see any regression in hallucination metric on the sampled eval set, kill the ramp.
Maya: Agreed on thresholds. I'll update the release notes and include the eval set link.
Deploy Bot: Scheduled rollout for thread 6832109876 will start at 22:05 UTC. Actions: pin model for cohort, set ff_slew_cohort -> 1%, wait 10m, set -> 10%, wait 20m, set -> 50%. Will post each step.
Chris: Operational checklist for oncall: 1) Watch p50/p95 latency 2) watch error spikes 3) watch memory/gpu pods 4) be ready to run rollback steps below.
Sam: Copying rollback commands here for quick paste:
```
# disable flag entirely
ffctl set ff_slew_cohort 0 --env production
# pin routing back to previous model
apictl set-route model-routing --version v2.0
# force-deploy canary to previous image
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-router-canary
```
Olga: Also leaving a note: if we hit transient oscillation (flag % bouncing) don't manually toggle back and forth. Use deploy-bot pause + ops to drain.
Maya: Good call. We'll rely on deploy-bot to pause between steps if it detects instability.
Deploy Bot: 22:05 UTC — starting rollout. Setting `ff_slew_cohort` -> 1% (pinned to v2.1 for cohort). Posting telemetry hooks to #eng-oncall.
Chris: First 10m in progress. No anomalies so far. GPU util steady at 42%.
Sam: monitoring dashboards looking clean. Running scheduled smoke tests against cohort.
Deploy Bot: 22:15 UTC — increasing `ff_slew_cohort` -> 10%.
Olga: Hit a small p95 blip at 22:18 (up 18%), still under threshold. Error rate flat. Holding.
Maya: Hold on further ramp for 5m to give traces time to converge.
Deploy Bot: Pausing next step for 5m per ops request.
Chris: After 5m hold, metrics stabilized. Ready to continue.
Deploy Bot: Resuming — setting `ff_slew_cohort` -> 50%.
Sam: Post-ramp checks: smoke tests OK, no increased hallucination on sampled eval, error rate 0.12%.
Olga: I confirm no anomalies on traces. If anything spikes overnight, we should drain cohorts back to 0% and pin to v2.0.
Maya: Great — moving to post-deploy monitoring. I'll update the release notes: will include rollout times, pin details, and rollback commands. Thanks all. :tada:
Deploy Bot: Rollout complete to 50% at 22:40 UTC. Thread closed unless new alerts appear.
